tasks.title: Doctor remediation core: python row, winget installs, one-confirm batching
tasks.objective: doctor tells the truth about Python and fixes Windows itself: a required python>=3.10 row mirrored into fast_status, winget user-scope-first installs for Git/Python with a single elevated PowerShell batch as the only elevation (one UAC confirm per run), same-run convergence via in-process PATH refresh, and forge next naming doctor --fix.
acceptance_criteria: A required python row (version-floored >= 3.10, probing py -3 / python3 / python) joins cmd_doctor AND fast_status (doctor.py:422 two-site agreement pinned by a test); the git row's fix string is platform-branched per the _direnv_fix_message pattern (doctor.py:745); HOOK_HEALTH_FIX's install promise becomes true.

New _install_git_windows/_install_python_windows behind the _install_direnv dispatcher shape (doctor.py:724): winget presence probe (absent -> required red row naming manual installer URLs, never a bundled download); user-scope-first winget installs (--scope user --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements) via direct subprocess.run with an installer-scale timeout (run_quiet's 15s at common.py:17 is UNTOUCHED at all ~15 existing sites); when and only when user scope is refused, ONE Start-Process -Verb RunAs PowerShell invocation carrying ALL pending installs — one UAC confirm per doctor run, never per package (decision 0039).

Same-run convergence: after installs, os.environ['PATH'] is extended with known install locations (pattern _prepend_user_bin_to_path doctor.py:624) and the checks re-probe so the fixing run reports green; the mixed partial-convergence state (git ok, python refused) stays idempotent for a re-run.

Tests via argv-recording monkeypatch fakes (patterns at test_gates.py:2836/12108): EXACTLY ONE elevation-shaped invocation carrying both package ids and zero per-package elevations; winget-absent red row; PATH-refresh convergence with stub executables (pattern :2857); python-row/fast_status agreement. No real winget calls in tests; nothing widens the windows CI selector here (D-0020).
Decision 0039 text refined if implementation reveals corrections; status stays proposed.
verify_commands: uvx --with pytest python3 -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "doctor_fix or python_row or winget or hook_health"
tasks.reviewer_focus: The one-confirm invariant is the contract: any code path that can produce two elevation prompts in one run is a blocking finding. subprocess/launcher behavior matters (recorded lesson): check the elevated batch's argument construction for quoting/injection surface, the installer timeout, and that no user-global config file is written. run_quiet must remain untouched. POSIX behavior byte-identical except the new python row.

tasks.title: Launcher python3 probe + flow remediation wiring + docs + CI selector
tasks.objective: The remediation reaches users where they enter: forge.cmd probes python3.exe as the last fallback (D-0018), init/adopt/upgrade tails run the fast hook check on Windows and invoke the same one-confirm remediation when red, docs state the Windows story, and the new doctor tests join the explicit windows CI selector.
acceptance_criteria: forge.cmd gains a :python3_fallback label (py -3 -> python -> python3 -> missing) with the same >= 3.10 version gate; the two cross-platform text assertions update in the same change (count of the version-gate string becomes 3; the where-index chain extends to python3) — test_gates.py:2660/2672.

On Windows only, the tails of cmd_init/cmd_adopt/cmd_upgrade run the fast hook check and, when red, invoke the shared --fix remediation (one-confirm guarantee carries through); placement after write_manifest is safe because remediation mutates no vendored files; POSIX flows byte-identical; upgrade.py changes are TAIL-ONLY — any copy-path change trips the repository-escape escalation tripwire.
docs/getting-started.md's install list gains the Windows prerequisites; new short docs/windows.md documents supported path, remediation flow, WSL2 escape hatch; degraded-mode.md cross-links it.
The new doctor test node ids from WIN-2.1 join the windows-hook-gates explicit selector (factory-scaffold.yml:88-96, -q stays last); the selector remains an explicit list (D-0020 forbids widening).
Full POSIX suite green; propagation tests from WIN-1 stay green.
verify_commands: uvx --with pytest python3 -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "forge_cmd or doctor_fix or init or upgrade"
tasks.reviewer_focus: upgrade.py tail-only (tripwire); remediation must not run on POSIX nor mutate vendored files; the selector edit keeps the explicit-id shape; forge.cmd keeps the .exe allowlist and no-call invariants from 0038 — flag any regression of those.
